title: Studio Backstage (3 Nhân Vật)
description: Mô phỏng hậu trường với 2 models, 1 nhiếp ảnh gia và âm thanh dialogue.
author: Tôi Là Tùng
template:
Slow cinematic tracking shot starting from behind the photographer's shoulder, smoothly pushing forward over 8 seconds to reveal the two fashion models in front of the camera. Gentle right-to-left orbiting arc at eye level, perfect cinematic framing and depth of field.

Exact same three characters from all attached reference images:
- Girl 1 (left model in black crop top): perfect face lock, identical body proportion, black crop top with graphic logo, baggy jeans, zero drift.
- Girl 2 (right model in red leather jacket): perfect face lock, identical body proportion, red leather jacket, black skirt, zero drift.
- Guy 1 (photographer in background/foreground, wearing grey hoodie): consistent facial features, holding a professional DSLR camera.
Perfect clothing consistency, realistic lighting interaction between all three characters.

Action sequence with precise timing:
0-2s: Guy 1 (photographer) lowers his camera slightly with a satisfied expression. Girl 1 and Girl 2 are striking high-fashion poses.
2-5s: Guy 1 gives a hand gesture and says something. Girl 1 breaks character, smiles and looks at Girl 2. Girl 2 naturally shifts her weight and laughs softly.
5-8s: Subtle hair strands flowing in light breeze, realistic fabric movement on all outfits, natural micro-interactions.

Professional photography studio background, large softbox lighting rigs visible in the frame, concrete floor, dramatic cinematic lighting setup, shallow depth of field, beautiful bokeh.

Hyperrealistic 8K fashion film, behind-the-scenes editorial style, professional studio photography quality, ultra-detailed fabric texture, smooth 24fps motion, natural physics, extremely high detail.
